verdict.rationale: Column is explicit that it is itself a nationally chartered bank (Column N.A.), not middleware or a partner-bank arrangement, per probe evidence and community confirmation that Column is 'an issuing bank and sponsor.' FDIC insurance for end-customer FBO accounts is documented, giving founders some clarity on fund safety. However, there is no explicit disclosure of what happens to customer funds/accounts if Column itself fails (e.g., FDIC pass-through insurance mechanics, wind-down procedures, or regulatory safeguards), and no comparison framing to help founders distinguish Column's model from partner-bank or middleware models. missing for 10: explicit failure/wind-down disclosure for customers, pass-through FDIC insurance mechanics, independent verification of charter status beyond self-description.
